title: Meta has released Muse Spark Open, a very large open-weight AI model built to run on Apple's Mac computers.
key_facts: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, which it calls the most capable open-weight model in the United States
816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window
Natively multimodal; built for complex coding and agentic work
Designed to run locally on Apple computers; needs at least 1 TB of RAM per Engadget; runs best on Mac Studio with M5 Ultra
Meta claims better performance than other popular open-weight models based on evaluation results it released on Thursday
Meta paired it with its Muse Code coding terminal and tested it on a Mastodon client fix and DaVinci Resolve footage review
Available now through several API platforms
quote_evidence: Meta has launched what it calls the "most capable" open-weight model in the United States.
However, you will still need a lot of power to run the model locally, with a requirement of at least 1 terabyte of RAM, per Engadget.
Meta is making the new model available now through a number of different API platforms.
why_it_matters_hint: Open-weight models can be cheaper and more transparent than closed ones, but this one needs very expensive hardware.
notes: Full text from fulltext file. Performance claims are Meta's own.
